nodes.title: Add a static durability lint (QC001-QC006) to workflow validate
nodes.body:
Closes #154.

Part of #99.

Workflow bodies are replayed, so code that reads the clock, discards an effect's promise, races effects, or reuses an effect ID in a loop behaves differently on resume than on the first run. Until now only runtime guards caught some of this, and only after a run had started. This adds a static lint that finds these hazards before import, using the type check's own `ts.P
